BETA Close X The Sage Group PLC has announced the purchase of 418,930 ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange and multilateral trading facilities at a volume-weighted average price of 891.1700 pence per share, with the highest price paid being 910.8000 pence and the lowest at 880.0000 pence. These shares were acquired from Morgan Stanley & Co. International plc as part of the share buyback program initiated on March 2, 2026, which is scheduled to conclude by June 5, 2026. All acquired shares will be cancelled. Disclaimer* Sage Group PLC (The) 23 April 2026 THE SAGE GROUP PLC TRANSACTION IN OWN SHARES The Sage Group plc ("Sage" or the "Group") announces today that it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 1 ⁴/₇₇ pence each on the London Stock Exchange and Multilateral Trading Facilities from Morgan Stanley & Co. International plc ("Morgan Stanley"). This is pursuant to the share buyback programme announced on 2 March 2026 which is expected to end no later than 5 June 2026.
